item.title: 4-Week Intermediate Cumbia with Mireille: SEPTEMBER 29 – OCTOBER 20 — Tue Sep 29, 7:30 PM — Salsa Dance Marin
item.description:
4-Week Series | Tuesdays at 7:30 PM
SEPTEMBER 29 – OCTOBER 20
Take Your Cumbia to the Next Level
Ready to level up your “Step of the Soul”? Join us for a high-energy, Intermediate Cumbia series designed to take you beyond the basics and inject flavor, intricate patterns, and advanced musicality into your dance. If you are comfortable with the basic rhythm and ready to challenge your footwork and partner work, this class is for you!
Prerequisite: Completion of the Beginner Cumbia series \(or equivalent foundational experience\) is required.
4-Week Intermediate Cumbia Series Program
Week 1 – Intermediate Foundations & Complex Timing
• Quick review of basic steps \(Tropical and Sonidera\) and rhythm check
• Introduction to syncopated footwork and advanced timing shifts
• Enhancing partner connection: tension, compression, and frame control for faster transitions
• Intermediate partner work combination with dynamic direction changes
Week 2 – Advanced Turns, Traveling, & Precisio

item.title: Entering a World of Awe and Spontaneity: Notes from a Journeyman Diviner -- with Stuart Goodnick — Thu Oct 1, 8:00 AM — Many Rivers Books & Tea
item.description: Stuart Goodnick, Dagara Stick and Voice Diviner, and co-founder of Many Rivers Books & Tea ​ The modern world in which we live is one of transactions. We do to get. We play out scripts that have been served up to us from the society in which we are enmeshed. Our lives have become mediated by screens which display a world of objects that we struggle to negotiate. The result leaves us feeling an undercurrent of emptiness and a vague sense that meaning is missing from our lives. Indigenous ways of living teach us that the world is alive and filled with spirit. Such traditions demonstrate a relational way of being in which all beings, be they human, animal, plant, or mineral are alive and in ongoing conversation with us. All we need to do is to learn to listen. ​ Join us for a demonstration and discussion about how indigenous practices such as Dagara Stick Divination and the cosmology from which it emerges, provides a gateway through which we can enter and productively engage with a world

item.title: Chris Jorgensen Gallery Evening and Norwegian Folk Art — Thu Oct 1, 5:00 PM — Sonoma State Historic Park
item.description:
The **Christian Jorgensen Gallery** inside the Mission at **Sonoma State Historic Park) will be open 5 P.M.-7 P.M., Thursday, October 1st!** This will be our final Sonoma Art Walk event of the 2026 season. We will be **celebrating Jorgensen's October Birthday and the Gallery's 75th Anniversary**! The gallery features 57 original watercolor paintings of California missions that Chris Jorgensen created between 1903 and 1905. We’ll do a deep dive into the exquisite details of C.J.’s paintings with tools and materials provided. **In honor of C.J.'s Norwegian heritage,** Sonoma State Historic Park is pleased to collaborate with **Sons of Norway, Freya Lodge** of Santa Rosa. The lodge will present a collection of traditional Norwegian folk arts which will be on display at the central table inside the gallery. Enjoy live music of Norway while perusing the art, plus other surprises! Free admission.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Napa Valley Museum Yountville FREE Oct 3-4 Bank of America Museums on Us — Sat Oct 3, 10:00 AM — Napa Valley Museum
item.description:
Bank of America cardholders receive free general admission to participating museums nationwide on the first full weekend of each month; this month is October 3-4.
As a chill settles in the air, Halloween costumes are planned, and leaves crunch on the ground, take a moment this busy fall season to enjoy a very special exhibit in your own backyard! The Napa Valley Museum Yountville has exciting exhibits including Mary Blair: Mid-Century Magic, a special exhibition by the Walt Disney Family Museum exploring the creative vision and achievements of one of Walt Disney’s most imaginative and renowned designers and art directors. Mary’s work appeared in classic Disney animated films like Cinderella \(1950\), Alice in Wonderland \(1951\), and Peter Pan \(1953\). The exhibit closes October 25, 2026, so it might be your last chance to make it before it’s gone!
Bank of America Museums on Us program offers FREE weekend general admission on the first full weekend of every month to Bank of America

item.description:

item.title: Fall in the Garden: Planting and Caring for your California Natives — Sun Oct 4, 10:30 AM — Petaluma Bounty
item.description:
Join Sonoma County Master Gardeners Dandi Hagler and Kim Jacobs for a workshop on how to care for your California native plants this fall.
They'll walk through which plants benefit from pruning now versus later in the season, and how to identify plants that are setting seed, which provide valuable food sources for birds and other wildlife. They'll also cover broader plant care guidelines to keep your garden healthy year-round, along with irrigation strategies for newly installed plants. Whether you're adding California natives for the first time or maintaining what you already have, you'll leave with actionable advice on what to do now.
Source: Press Democrat

item.title: Ukrainian BBQ Benefit for Sister City Relief Effort — Sun Oct 4, 1:00 PM — Ragle Ranch Regional Park
item.description:
Ukrainian BBQ and Beer Fest Sunday, October 4th, 2026. 1:00pm-4:00pm Sebastopol World Friends presents an authentic Ukrainian BBQ (shashlik) and specially brewed Ukrainian beers: “Ukrainian IPA” from Crooked Goat Brewing, and “Zelensky’s Orange Juice” from John Kreidler a special friend of SWF. There will be plentiful Ukrainian snacks, BBQ, vegetarian options, beer, wine, and other beverages, Ukrainian music, and lots of fun. Proceeds support Sebastopol World Friends on-going efforts to fund renovation of a dormitory building in Chyhyryn, Ukraine (Sebastopol’s sister city) that will house hundreds of Internally Displaced People from areas of Ukraine who have been impacted by the war there. Tickets are $75 and are all inclusive. Tickets must be purchased in advance at https://www.tickettailor.com/events/sebastopolworldfriends/2286813. This event will sell out, so purchase tickets soon! For more information and ticket links go to sebastopolwf.org. Slava Ukraini!
Source: Sebastopol Calen

item.title: Festival Calentano — Sun Oct 4, 3:00 PM — Luther Burbank Center for the Arts
item.description:
Festival Calentano will be an unforgettable night of dancing in the LBC Pavillion. Dance to the sounds of Tierra Caliente and regional Mexican music with Humberto Plancarte’s Tierra Cali, a group from Michoacán known for its romantic style and signature Tierra Caliente sound. The celebration will also feature the high-energy sound of Alameños de la Sierra DMC, the musical tradition of Los Canarios de Michoacán, and the unmistakable technobanda rhythms of Banda Maguey. Festival Calentano será una gran noche de baile dedicada a los sonidos de Tierra Caliente y la música regional mexicana. Encabezando el festival estará Humberto Plancarte’s Tierra Cali, agrupación originaria de Michoacán reconocida por su estilo romántico y su característico sonido calentano. La celebración también contará con la energía de Alameños de la Sierra DMC, la tradición musical de Los Canarios de Michoacán y el inconfundible ritmo technobanda de Banda Maguey.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
